verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents Foreloop notifying a developer when an agent finishes a task or needs input. The closest items are adjacent and do not count as notifications: an Agents dashboard row showing each worker's task and last message, a pre-run approval gate, and a marketing line about approving big calls from a phone. Pull requests opened on GitHub are a host-platform behavior, not a Foreloop notification.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input
